events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your dispute and you're getting a full refund of the $6.61 cancellation fee, paid as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: the driver cancelled and said you were a no-show, but the trip records show he tapped "I'm Here" while about 351 metres from the pickup point — never closer than 319 metres — and he stayed under 200 metres away for zero seconds afterwards. Because the arrival wasn't at the pickup point, the cancellation fee doesn't stand and comes back to you in full.

No action is needed from you. Thanks for flagging this.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation on this trip. The $6.61 cancellation fee charged to the rider is being refunded to them as a Ryde voucher, so it won't be paid out to you.

What decided it: records show your "I'm Here" tap was made about 351 metres from the pickup point, and you were never within 200 metres of it at any point or for any period after the tap. Your arrival confirmation therefore doesn't meet the requirement that you be at the pickup point and wait there.

Separately, your account has been flagged and sent to Ryde review for the arrival and cancellation button use on this trip. No further action is needed from you right now; we'll follow up if the review needs anything.
